Test Point: Verify successful login with valid credentials
How To Test:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter valid email and password
3. Click Login button
Expected Result: User should be redirected to the dashboard
Actual Result: User is successfully redirected to the dashboard

Test Point: Verify error message with invalid password
How To Test:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter valid email and invalid password
3. Click Login button
Expected Result: System should display 'Invalid credentials' error message
Actual Result: Error message appears but text is not styled correctly

Test Point: Verify user can update profile picture
How To Test:
1. Go to Profile
2. Click 'Upload Picture'
3. Select valid image file
4. Save
Actual Result: Image uploads but page requires manual refresh to see changes
